name: Mihama (Fukui, Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Mihama town emblem in white: a triquetra of three interlocking loops enclosing stylised strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Mihama, a town in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1958.

features.role: Mihama town emblem — a triquetra of three interlocking loops enclosing stylised strokes
